title: May We Thy Precepts, Lord, Fulfil
description: May We Thy Precepts, Lord, Fulfil in Tonic Solfa to MERIBAH, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Edward Osler wrote these words. They were printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 339.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Particular Metre (8.8.6.8.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to MERIBAH; any other Common Particular Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: May we Thy pre-cepts, Lord, ful-fil And do on earth our Fa-ther’s will As an-gels do a-bove; Still walk in Christ, the liv-ing Way, With all Thy child-ren and o-bey The law of Chris-tian love.

lines: May we Thy precepts, Lord, fulfil
And do on earth our Father’s will
Still walk in Christ, the living Way,
With all Thy children and obey
So may we join Thy name to bless,
Thy grace adore, Thy power confess,
From sin and strife to flee.
One is our calling, one our name,
The end of all our hopes the same,
A crown of life with Thee.
Spirit of Life, of Love and Peace,
Unite our hearts, our joy increase,
To each of us the blessing give

licence: Public domain: Edward Osler died in 1863.
credits: Words by Edward Osler (1798–1863), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to MERIBAH by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
